# 📥 Installation Guide

BeyondTexturePack is compatible with all Minecraft 1.21.x versions. To install the pack, simply download the **.zip** file and place it into your Minecraft resourcepacks folder. After that, open Minecraft, go to Options → Resource Packs, and enable the pack.

Not sure if the pack was installed correctly? You should immediately notice the custom totem, redesigned health and hunger bars, and the custom crosshair once you join a world.

BeyondTexturePack is designed to keep the vanilla Minecraft style while adding a cleaner and more modern visual experience. The pack works perfectly for survival, PvP, and casual gameplay without changing the core feel of Minecraft.

# ✨ Features
**Custom Totem
Personalized Health Bar
Personalized Hunger Bar
Custom Crosshair
Vanilla-Friendly Style
Compatible with all Minecraft 1.21.x versions**
## Credits to: Xisumavoid for the "vanilla tweaks" page
# ✅ Compatibility

BeyondTexturePack works with vanilla Minecraft and is also compatible with most popular mod loaders and clients, including Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge. No extra mods are required to use the pack. 😎
